key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Top bar section for the Bluetooth button

key.name: hide-when-disconnected
key.summary: Hide the button when nothing is connected
key.description: When off, the button stays in the top bar with the Bluetooth icon, so the card can turn the radio on and connect paired devices.

key.name: hidden-devices
key.summary: Devices left out of the card
key.description: Bluetooth addresses. They stay paired in the system.

key.name: low-battery-threshold
key.description: At or below this battery level a device is shown in red. 0 turns the warning off.
